query: Did Coupang (coupang.com) disclose a data breach exposing customer accounts? I'm a cybersecurity vendor evaluating outreach. Confirm whether a breach occurred, how many customer accounts were affected, the root cause (e.g. insider, stolen credentials, third-party), the dates of exposure and disclosure, and what categories of personal data were involved. Include source URLs and dates.

Has Conduent (conduent.com) confirmed a ransomware attack or data breach in the last 12 months? I need this as a sales signal for a managed detection and response provider. Report the attack type, which government agencies or clients were affected, how many individuals' records were exposed, whether benefit recipients' SSNs were involved, and the disclosure date. Cite sources.

Was Carnival Corporation (carnival.com) the target of a social-engineering or account-compromise attack in 2026? Determine the entry point (e.g. a single employee account), the date the unauthorized activity was identified and contained, what personal information was copied, and how many customers or employees were notified. Include source links and dates for a security-vendor prospecting list.

Did Navia Benefit Solutions (naviabenefits.com) suffer a data breach affecting plan participants? As a breach-response and identity-protection vendor I want to confirm the number of people impacted, the data types exposed (names, DOB, SSN, contact info, benefits data), the window of unauthorized access, and the breach notification date. Provide sources.

Has Odido (odido.nl) publicly disclosed a cyberattack affecting its customer base? Report how many customers were potentially affected, the dates unauthorized access was detected, what data was accessed, and any regulator notification. I'm assembling a list of recently-breached telecom operators for security outreach — include source URLs and dates.

Is there any report that data was stolen from Telus (telus.com) in 2026, including claims circulating on dark-web or breach forums? Verify the claimed volume of stolen data, whether Telus confirmed or denied it, the threat actor or forum involved, and the date. Flag whether this is confirmed or unverified. This is for a threat-intelligence sales signal — cite sources.

Did Vietnam Airlines (vietnamairlines.com) experience a leak of customer records that appeared on a hacking forum? Confirm the approximate number of records, the type of data, when it was posted, and whether the airline acknowledged the incident. Include source links and dates for a security-vendor prospecting record.

Was Mt. Spokane Pediatrics hit by ransomware, and did the LockBit group claim responsibility? Report the number of individuals notified, what protected health information was compromised, the date of the attack, and any ransom/publication threat timeline. I want this as an outreach signal for a healthcare-focused security firm. Cite sources.

Did the University of Mississippi Medical Center (umc.edu) suffer a ransomware attack that disrupted clinical operations? Determine which systems were affected (EHR, IT), whether clinics closed and when they reopened, and whether patient data was exposed. Include dates and source URLs for a healthcare-cybersecurity sales signal.

Was Change Healthcare's ransomware breach the largest healthcare data breach on record, and how many patient records were ultimately confirmed stolen? Report the final affected-individual count, the attacking group, the disclosure timeline, and the estimated financial impact. I'm referencing this in security-vendor outreach to similarly-exposed payers — cite sources and dates.

In the last 6 months, has any healthcare or insurance company disclosed a breach affecting more than 1 million individuals? List each company, the affected-record count, the breach type, the disclosure date, and a source URL. I'm building a target list of recently-breached organizations for a security vendor's outbound campaign.

Has Oracle (oracle.com) been linked to any data-security incident, customer-environment compromise, or breach disclosure in 2025-2026? Confirm what was reported, which systems or customers were implicated, whether Oracle confirmed it, and the dates. Flag confirmed vs. alleged. Include sources for a security-vendor sales signal.

Which companies have disclosed a breach in the last 90 days that was attributed to a third-party or supply-chain vendor compromise? For each, name the breached company, the implicated vendor, the data affected, and the disclosure date with a source URL. This is a target list for a third-party-risk-management vendor's outreach.

Has any major retailer or e-commerce company disclosed a payment-card or customer-data breach in 2026? List the company, the number of customers affected, the attack vector, and the disclosure date with sources. I'm prioritizing recently-breached retailers for a PCI/security vendor outreach list.

Has a publicly traded US company filed an 8-K disclosing a material cybersecurity incident in the last 3 months? For each, identify the company, the date of the 8-K, a summary of the incident as disclosed, and a link to the filing or coverage. I want SEC-disclosed breaches as a sales signal for an incident-response retainer.

Has any company recently disclosed exploitation of a zero-day or critical CVE in its environment? Identify the company, the CVE or affected product, whether active exploitation was confirmed, and the date of disclosure with sources. This is for outreach by a vulnerability-management and patch-prioritization vendor.

Did GitLab (gitlab.com) appoint a new Chief Information Security Officer in 2026? Confirm the executive's name, their start/announcement date, their background, and what the appointment signals about GitLab's security investment. I'm a security-tooling vendor timing outreach to a new CISO — include the announcement source and date.

Has LogicGate (logicgate.com) named a new CISO recently? Report the name, the announcement date, the scope of the role, and any stated security or GRC priorities. New security leaders often re-evaluate their stack, so I want this as an outreach signal — cite the source.

Did Black Duck (blackduck.com) appoint a new Chief Information Security Officer, and who is it? Confirm the name, their prior experience, and the announcement date. I'm building a list of companies with newly-installed CISOs to target with a security platform — include source URLs and dates.

Has any company announced a new CISO, CIO, or VP of Security in the last 60 days? List each company, the executive's name, the role, the prior employer, and the announcement date with a source URL. New security-leadership hires are my primary buying signal — prioritize the most recent appointments.

Has any SaaS company hired a new Chief Revenue Officer or VP of Sales in 2026? A new revenue leader typically reviews the GTM tech stack within 90 days. List the company, the executive, their prior role, and the announcement date with sources — this is an outreach signal for a sales-enablement vendor.

Which companies have appointed a new Chief Financial Officer in the last quarter? List the company, the CFO's name, their previous employer, and the announcement date with source links. New CFOs frequently re-evaluate finance and procurement tooling — I'm using this as a buying signal for a spend-management platform.

Has any company named a new Chief Marketing Officer recently? List the company, the CMO, their background, and the announcement date with sources. New marketing leaders often reassess martech and agency relationships, so I want recent CMO appointments as outreach triggers.

Did Wonderful raise a Series B in 2026, and at what valuation? Confirm the amount raised, the valuation, the lead investor, participating investors, and the date. Companies that just raised growth capital are expanding teams and tooling, so I want this as a sales signal — include the announcement source.

Did TensorWave close a Series B led by Nvidia's venture arm in June 2026? Confirm the amount, the lead and participating investors, the date, and what the company will use the capital for. I'm targeting newly-funded AI infrastructure companies for outreach — cite sources.

Did Unframe raise a Series B in 2026? Report the amount, the lead investor, the participating funds, the company's stated traction (e.g. contract value), and the date. Newly-funded enterprise-AI startups are my target segment — include source URLs and the round date.

Which AI startups raised a Series A or Series B of $20M or more in the last 60 days? For each, list the company, the round size, the lead investor, and the announcement date with a source URL. Newly-funded companies scale headcount fast — I'm building an outreach list for a recruiting/HR platform.

Has any cybersecurity startup raised funding in 2026? List the company, the round stage and size, the investors, and the date with sources. I'm a channel/partnerships lead looking for recently-funded security companies as co-sell or integration partners — prioritize the most recent rounds.

Which biotech or healthtech companies closed a Series B or later round in 2026? For each, give the company, the amount, the lead investor, and the date with a source URL. Newly-capitalized life-sciences companies expand lab and compliance operations — I'm using funding events as a sales signal.

Has any company raised a mega-round (over $100M) in the last 30 days? List the company, the amount, the round stage, the lead investor, and the date with sources. Large raises trigger rapid spend on infrastructure and headcount — I want the freshest mega-rounds as outreach triggers.

Did Oracle (oracle.com) announce significant layoffs in 2026? Confirm the estimated number of roles cut, which divisions were affected, how the cuts were communicated, and the date. Companies reorganizing after layoffs often consolidate vendors — I'm using this as an outreach signal. Cite sources.

Did Block (block.xyz / Square) reduce its workforce in early 2026, and by how much? Report the before/after headcount, the percentage cut, the stated rationale, and the date with sources. I'm a vendor that helps teams do more with fewer people — recent layoffs are my buying signal.

Which tech companies announced layoffs in the last 60 days that explicitly cited AI or automation as a factor? For each, list the company, the number of roles affected, the AI rationale, and the date with a source URL. I'm targeting companies restructuring around AI for an outreach campaign.

Has any company announced layoffs affecting more than 1,000 employees in 2026? List the company, the number of roles, the affected functions, and the announcement date with sources. Large layoffs trigger outplacement, severance, and benefits-administration needs — I'm building a target list for an HR-services vendor.

Did Epic Games or Wix announce layoffs in 2026? For each, confirm the number of roles cut, the percentage of the workforce, the stated reason, and the date with sources. I want recently-downsized gaming and SaaS companies as outreach targets — cite the source for each.

Did Roche agree to acquire PathAI in 2026? Confirm the deal structure, the announcement date, the strategic rationale (e.g. AI-driven diagnostics), and whether the deal has closed. Post-acquisition integration creates tooling and migration needs — I'm using M&A as a sales signal. Include sources.

Did Boston Scientific enter a definitive agreement to acquire Penumbra in 2026? Report the deal value, the per-share or total consideration, the announcement date, and the expected close. I'm targeting companies in active M&A integration for a systems-integration vendor — cite sources and dates.

Did AstraZeneca agree to acquire Modella AI in early 2026? Confirm the announcement date, the strategic purpose (e.g. oncology development), and any disclosed terms. Acquisitions of AI companies signal data-integration and governance spend — I want this as an outreach trigger. Include sources.

Which mergers or acquisitions over $1B were announced in 2026? For each, list the acquirer, the target, the deal value, and the announcement date with a source URL. Newly-announced deals trigger integration, HR-harmonization, and IT-consolidation projects — I'm building an M&A-driven outreach list.

Did Devon Energy and Coterra Energy announce a merger in 2026, and what is the transaction value? Confirm the deal size, the structure, the announcement date, and the combined-company rationale. I'm an integration-services vendor targeting energy-sector consolidation — cite sources and dates.

Did the European Commission issue its first Digital Services Act fine, and against which company? Confirm the company fined, the penalty amount, the violations cited, and the date. Companies hit with regulatory penalties invest in compliance tooling — I'm using enforcement actions as a sales signal. Include sources.

Which companies received GDPR fines above €10 million in 2025-2026? For each, list the company, the fine amount, the violation, the issuing authority, and the date with a source URL. Recently-fined organizations are my target market for a data-privacy compliance platform — prioritize the most recent and largest fines.

When does enforcement of the EU AI Act begin, and what penalties apply to high-risk AI systems? Confirm the enforcement start date, the maximum penalty (amount and percentage of global turnover), and which obligations take effect. I sell AI-governance tooling and want to time outreach to the enforcement deadline — cite official sources.

Has the FTC announced any settlement or enforcement action against a company in the last 6 months over data privacy or security practices? For each, list the company, the settlement amount, the alleged conduct, and the date with a source URL. I'm using FTC actions as a buying signal for a privacy-compliance vendor.

Which companies have been fined by a data-protection authority in 2026 for inadequate security measures (as opposed to consent or transparency failures)? List the company, the fine, the authority, the security failing cited, and the date with sources. This is an outreach list for a security-controls and audit vendor.

Has SpaceX (spacex.com) filed an S-1 IPO prospectus with the SEC, and what did it disclose about its finances? Confirm the filing date, the disclosed revenue figures and period, and the planned roadshow timing. Companies preparing to IPO ramp up audit, security, and financial-controls spend — I'm using IPO filings as a sales signal. Cite sources.

Did Anthropic confidentially file a draft S-1 registration statement with the SEC in 2026? Confirm the filing date, the targeted valuation and raise size, and whether it would be among the largest IPOs ever. I'm targeting pre-IPO companies for SOX-readiness and controls tooling — include source URLs and dates.

Which companies confidentially or publicly filed for an IPO in 2026? For each, list the company, the filing type (confidential S-1 or public), the targeted valuation if disclosed, and the date with a source URL. Pre-IPO companies are my target for audit, security-maturity, and equity-management vendors — prioritize the most recent filings.

Which companies announced a new office, headquarters, or geographic expansion in the last 90 days? For each, list the company, the location, the scale (e.g. square footage or planned headcount), and the announcement date with a source URL. New locations trigger facilities, payroll, and IT-provisioning spend — I'm using expansion news as an outreach signal.

Which companies have posted a surge in open job requisitions in 2026, signaling rapid headcount growth? For each, identify the company, the functions hiring most (e.g. sales, engineering), the approximate number of open roles, and a source URL with a date. Fast-growing headcount drives onboarding, HRIS, and security-provisioning needs — I want hiring surges as a buying signal.
